_readme: How each layer the edit sets on top LOOKS and where it SITS — settings, never per-video decisions, and never a brand name. Fonts are ids from looks/fonts.json (`font` for body, `font_heavy` for display). Where a layer sits is a `zone` id from looks/placement.json — never a raw height; every zone already clears the platforms' buttons (machine/defaults.json → safe_zones.surfaces) and moves off a face when production marks one. `text` holds the spacing every text layer uses (one normal space between words). Platform UI styles live in looks/platform_ui.json, icons in looks/icons.json. A layer's words come from the plan, never from here. Only the owner signs a row approved.

review.what: A review card: five stars, a name, the review text.

comment.what: A social comment: round avatar, handle, the comment in a bubble.

dm.what: A text thread: bubbles alternating them / us, newest last.

site.what: A web page: an address bar and the page's headline block.

order.what: An order confirmation: a tick, 'Order confirmed', the rows.

search.what: A search bar with the query typed in, results under it.

platform_ui._moved: looks/platform_ui.json — one style row per kind, each with its own drawn spec, font id and zone

text.what: every text layer: one normal space between words, the font's own letter spacing
